long_biography.plain_text:
Pytka began behind the camera in Pittsburgh, working at WRS Motion Pictures and making documentaries for public television. Commercials for a local brewery introduced him to short-form advertising and supplied a repeatable paid market for his documentary instincts. As assignments expanded internationally, he opened his own production company, PYTKA, turning directing and production into the business behind his career.

His company executed campaigns for brands including Pepsi, Nike, McDonald's and Budweiser, combining agency concepts with his own performance-driven filmmaking. Pytka also directed music videos and feature films, most notably Space Jam, which grew from a Nike commercial pairing Michael Jordan with Bugs Bunny. Those projects broadened his cultural reach, but advertising production remained the durable commercial engine: a client-funded directing practice, global shoot network and independently controlled production house.
